items.title: Vythizomai - Yiorgos Fanourakis / Live on Lohača Hill, Slovenia
items.description:
A half-tuned guitar,

a guitar magnet made from an old Casio watch and Martin's ingenuity,

a twenty-something microphone standing on a fallen branch,

an afternoon that plunges into the darkness before our eyes, as if the lights go out to start the show

and our audience: Scottish bulls and horses who, with gentle curiosity, get closer and closer to the hill as we play music.

Lights, cameras, avanti nature.

Lohača, Slovenia
29.09.2025

items.title: O! Kali mou xanthia - Manos Hadjidakis (performed by Yiorgos Fanourakis)
items.description:
Municipality of Crete Youth Symphony Orchestra
Youth Choir of the Municipality of Heraklion
"Nikos Kazantzakis" Garden Theater
3 July 2018

'Oh, my dear blonde.'
Aristophanes, Birds
composer: Manos Hadjidakis
poetry: Vasilis Rotas

Conductor: Miltos Logiadis
Artistic direction: Ioannis Idomeneos
Performance: Yiorgos Fanourakis

Lyrics
Oh! my dear blonde,
my sweet companion,
that I talk with you
every nice cause,
came, came, Fanis
with suraurus to weave
hymns, singing,
spring sounds.

Go ahead, start, tell them
sweets for the restless.
